name: Singapore American School
summary: Large US-curriculum campus in Woodlands with extensive co-curriculars and strong college counselling.
body: SAS is one of Singapore’s largest international schools, offering an American pathway from early childhood through high school. The Woodlands campus is a full-day commitment geographically — families often live north/west or accept longer drives. Waitlists and admissions cycles are competitive for popular grades; start early if your move is package-timed.
waitlistNotes: Plan 6–12 months ahead for peak grades; sibling priority applies.
